name: Workflow Watch for Orca
description: Every workflow run, live, beside your code. Watch Open Dynamic Workflows and AgentPrism runs in Orca's sidebar, from this computer and your paired servers: each phase and agent on a timeline, the whole run log, and a notification when a run finishes or needs you. A community plugin, not made or endorsed by Orca.

cover.alt: The headline “Every workflow run, live, beside your code.” beside the Workflows panel: a live run on its timeline and two recent runs.

screenshots.caption: Watch agents work in parallel
screenshots.alt: Dark Workflows panel with a live review-swarm run: five review agents as bars on the timeline, the phases to come and a token meter.

screenshots.caption: See where the time went
screenshots.alt: Light Workflows panel with a finished review-swarm run opened: how long each phase took, a skipped Apply phase, and a bar for every agent.

screenshots.caption: Read the whole run log
screenshots.alt: A plan-flow run's full event log in a dialog: completed tasks, a failed test gate, a failed reviewer, and a question waiting for the owner.

screenshots.caption: Two machines. One run history.
screenshots.alt: Light Workflows panel listing recent runs from a MacBook Pro and a Mac mini, each with its phases as a metro line, and a chip for each computer.

commands.title: Workflow Watch for Orca: Open Workflows

settings.title: Runs folder
settings.description: Where ODW keeps its runs: its runsRoot setting. ODW's default is ~/.odw/runs.

settings.title: AgentPrism runs folder
settings.description: Where AgentPrism Workflows keeps its runs: AGENTPRISM_PERSISTENCE_ROOT, or ~/.agentprism/workflows by default.

settings.title: Notify me
settings.description: A desktop notification when a run finishes, fails or waits at a checkpoint.

settings.title: Finished runs to show
settings.description: Live runs always show, however old.

settings.title: Metro line size
settings.description: How tall each finished run's line of stations and tracks draws in the history. compact fits more rows; large is easiest to read.

settings.title: Passed runs stay green for (minutes)
settings.description: How long the status bar shows a pass in green after its run ended. 0 never shows it green.

settings.title: Failed runs stay red for (minutes)
settings.description: How long the status bar shows a failure in red after its run ended, unless a newer run passes first. 0 never shows it red.

settings.title: Paired servers to watch
settings.description: auto: every paired Orca server that runs this plugin too. Or a comma-separated list of server names, or off.

settings.title: Orca CLI path
settings.description: Leave empty to use the CLI inside the Orca app. The worker reads paired servers through it.
